description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Windshield Wiper Arm Stud Repair Kit.
It contains all the parts you need to re-seal your windshield frame around the wiper arm studs
Leaks in this area are the prime reason for rusted windshield frames.
Comes with everything you need to do both wiper arm studs.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Wiper Arm Stud Repair Kits (Does Both Wipers)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
